title: sdks: align auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go + parity & version bump v1.82.0
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics to reduce customer confusion and simplify docs/examples. This PR: 1) standardizes auth configuration across SDKs (support for REDWOOD_API_KEY env var, explicit Client(auth=...) constructors, and clearer error messages when credentials are missing), 2) consolidates retry policy defaults and exposes an overridable RetryPolicy object with exponential backoff / jitter parity, 3) improves streaming API ergonomics so streaming responses surface the same event and error hooks across languages, 4) fixes parity bugs discovered in model call option handling (especially around timeout propagation and metadata headers), and 5) bumps SDK versions to v1.82.0 (python/typescript/go) and updates CHANGELOGs.

Checklist:
- [x] Python: add RetryPolicy class, unify auth constructor, streaming iterator ergonomics
- [x] TypeScript: mirror RetryPolicy API, add explicit auth detection and helpful error, streaming on('data') + async iterator parity
- [x] Go: add RetryPolicy struct & functional options, support streaming via channel + context cancellation parity
- [x] Add cross-SDK integration tests for auth/retry/streaming flows
- [x] Update SDK docs and quickstarts
- [x] Version bumps and CHANGELOG entries

Implementation notes: to avoid API breakage we introduced thin adapter layers in each SDK that translate the new RetryPolicy to existing transport-level retry hooks. Streaming received a small compatibility shim: previously TS exposed both event callbacks and an async iterator; Python and Go had slightly different semantics for partial/complete/error events. We standardized on: events: 'data' (chunk), 'error' (terminal), 'end' (complete), and an async iterator yielding chunk objects. The shim ensures legacy callback users are unaffected.

review_comments: Marcus Li (2026-02-21): Nice consolidation. Please ensure retry defaults are documented and that the default max_retries is conservative for hosted clients. Also request a changelog entry per SDK.
Ava Chen (2026-02-21): Added docs and explicit changelog entries. Default max_retries is 2 for hosted API and 5 for Dedicated/private in RetryPolicy defaults.

Priya Kapoor (2026-02-22): Found an edge case where timeout from client call wasn't propagated into the Go streaming helper; pushed a fix to preserve context timeout. Can you add a unit test to cover this?
Ava Chen (2026-02-22): Added unit test for context timeout propagation in Go (see commits), and adjusted streaming cancellation to close underlying connection earlier to reduce resource usage.

Diego Morales (2026-02-23): Integration tests passed locally but one CI integration job failed intermittently on CI due to ephemeral quota in the test harness. Re-ran the job and it passed. Approving on green.
Marcus Li (2026-02-24): Minor nits in typescript typings for RetryPolicy; suggested change pushed (b2c3d4e -> updated).

release_notes: SDKs: unify auth, retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Introduces RetryPolicy API (configurable max_retries, backoff, jitter), standardized streaming events and iterator parity. Bug fixes for timeout propagation and metadata header handling. Version bump to v1.82.0 for all SDKs.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps adapter shims to avoid breaking existing user code; follow-up planned to deprecate legacy constructors in v1.84.0
Coordination required with docs release and package publish automation: publish order: python -> typescript -> go to minimize downstream breakage in samples
Regression monitoring: added SLO alerts to detect increase in client-side retry counts after release (ENG-14838)
